Welcome to No. 6 Seapoint Court Apartments, a well presented first floor apartment
ideally positioned with a wealth of amenities on your doorstep.
This own door apartment is presented in pristine condition throughout and only a short stroll to
Dart service and beach.
The accommodation comprises of a light filled livingroom with feature
fireplace, high timber ceiling, fully fitted kitchen, large bedroom with
built-in wardrobes, bathroom with bath and separate shower cubicle.
Communal gardens with storage shed for each apartment.
Excellent transport links, with the Dart service and bus routes just minutes away,
providing easy access to Dublin and beyond.
